Title: Powerbase: L.A. some oddities and queries

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
First off, this was an incredibly entertaining event, hats off to
Courtois and Goudie for making it so. Amongst the laughter,
frustration, sly smiles, looks of disgust, annoying diatribe, annoying
monotribe, desperate deal-making, opportunitive back-stabbing, great
strategems, bad luck, and awe inspiring TOP-DECK SKILLS, a Jyhad could
not be better well-defined or experienced. But, as the subject title
suggests, some incidents within require some notable attention:

Longest delay withing a round - a need for a judge ruling on weather a
vampire newly tempted ( Temptation action ) with one blood on it can
be Heidelberged extra blood to delay its temporary change of control.
This resolution would seem simpler than it appears due to official
rulings regarding the HC, so a confirmation on this scenario would be
appreciated.

Longest delay within a Final - The need for a player to 'black-back'
sleeve his library due to the fact that he had a mixed set of cards
from 'Jyhad' and 'Vampire' and was using Anatole's ability. There was
never a question of cheating involved, it was just the idea of an
accidental advantage due to the knowledge of which cards had been seen
and can be identified due to the printed set; 'Jyhad' cards can be
identified by back or face, so if only one 'Jyhad' card (or only one
'Vampire' card) was included in the top five, that information could
be used advantageously. Examples " I need at least 3 stealth to get
by this minion, and I see that on the top of my library is a 'Jyhad'
card, hmmmm, the only 'Jyhard' card that Anatole gave me a gander at
was a 'Lost In Crowds' so I'll go for it" or "There is a 'Vampire'
card on the top of my deck and that is not the card that I will need
to even attempt this action".

Most conjectured and discussed scenario that never came into play -
Whether a Darkling Trickery played on a Flame Thrower strike would
negate the opportunity for a Rotschrek to be played. I am pretty
certain of the correct answer but this one is for the edification of
the wonderful Tatu's ( not only great V:TES players but 2 of the
nicest, easy-going people you may ever meet ).

Scariest vampire during 3 days of continual V:TES - Arika with a Ghoul
Retainer and 2 Assault Rifles! Not only is she broken but she can
beat the shit out of you without a PTO!

Due to my touring schedules I do not get to play Jyhad as often as I'd
like to, but when I do I am very appreciative to have in my local
playgroup the likes of Paul Johnson, Mike Courtois, Darby Keenan,
Robert Goudie , Steve Bucy, Dennis Lien,and the newly relocated Alex
Harmon amongst many other dedicated, competitive and innovative V:TES
players (experienced and new).

Robert Scythe
